description.value: A prospective population-based neuroimaging study examining associations between prenatal cannabis and tobacco exposure and brain morphology in young children.

spans.text: In this prospective study, we investigated the association between prenatal cannabis exposure and brain morphology in young children.

description.value: Population-based prospective cohort study of 6- to 8-year-old children recruited from the Generation R Study.

spans.text: Subjects were recruited from an ongoing population-based prospective cohort, the Generation R Study.
